sql: select 'fill' k, f.market_ticker, f.filled_at::text t, o.action||' '||o.side||' lim '||o.limit_price||' fill '||f.side||' '||f.price||'c x'||f.quantity v from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and f.filled_at > '2026-10-20 09:40' union all select 'chg', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,status) from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and created_at > '2026-10-20 09:40' union all select 'pull', market_ticker, created_at::text, cancel_reason from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and cancel_reason in ('pre_event','fill_contagion') and created_at > '2026-10-17' union all select 'snap', market_ticker, at::text, best_yes_bid||'/'||best_no_bid from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker='KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT22-DIVI' order by market_ticker, at desc) x union all select 'open', 'count', '', count(*)::text from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and status in ('resting','partial','submitted')
